## Faults

- **Missing neck:** The head circle (center 405,112 r 32) and the body ellipse (center 315,195 ry 52) do not overlap; their closest edges are ~90 px apart horizontally, so the head appears to float in the air with no connection to the body.

## Corrected SVG

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 520">
  <!-- Ground -->
  <line x1="40" y1="470" x2="760" y2="470" stroke="#999" stroke-width="3"/>
  <!-- Shadows -->
  <ellipse cx="200" cy="466" rx="80" ry="7" fill="#000" opacity="0.1"/>
  <ellipse cx="560" cy="466" rx="80" ry="7" fill="#000" opacity="0.1"/>

  <!-- Wheels -->
  <g stroke="#444" fill="none" stroke-width="6">
    <circle cx="200" cy="380" r="72"/>
    <circle cx="560" cy="380" r="72"/>
  </g>
  <g stroke="#888" stroke-width="2">
    <line x1="128" y1="380" x2="272" y2="380"/>
    <line x1="149" y1="329" x2="251" y2="431"/>
    <line x1="200" y1="308" x2="200" y2="452"/>
    <line x1="149" y1="431" x2="251" y2="329"/>
    <line x1="488" y1="380" x2="632" y2="380"/>
    <line x1="509" y1="329" x2="611" y2="431"/>
    <line x1="560" y1="308" x2="560" y2="452"/>
    <line x1="509" y1="431" x2="611" y2="329"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="200" cy="380" r="8" fill="#444"/>
  <circle cx="560" cy="380" r="8" fill="#444"/>

  <!-- Frame -->
  <g stroke="#222" stroke-width="8" fill="none">
    <path d="M200,380 L370,380 L350,270 Z"/>
    <path d="M350,270 L545,270 L560,380"/>
    <path d="M370,380 L545,270"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Handlebar -->
  <path d="M545,270 L560,240 L588,240" stroke="#222" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="588" cy="240" r="6" fill="#666"/>
  <!-- Seat -->
  <line x1="350" y1="270" x2="348" y2="258" stroke="#222" stroke-width="5"/>
  <ellipse cx="346" cy="254" rx="24" ry="9" fill="#333"/>

  <!-- Crank & pedals -->
  <line x1="370" y1="380" x2="345" y2="418" stroke="#333" stroke-width="5"/>
  <line x1="370" y1="380" x2="395" y2="342" stroke="#333" stroke-width="5"/>
  <rect x="330" y="414" width="28" height="7" rx="3" fill="#555"/>
  <rect x="382" y="338" width="28" height="7" rx="3" fill="#555"/>
  <circle cx="370" cy="380" r="14" fill="#777"/>

  <!-- Pelican legs -->
  <g stroke="#f0a040" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="305" y1="235" x2="345" y2="416"/>
    <line x1="350" y1="230" x2="395" y2="340"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Pelican neck -->
  <path d="M330,180 Q360,140 395,115 L420,118 Q405,155 365,185 Z"
        fill="#f5f2ec" stroke="#c9c2b6" stroke-width="3"/>
  <!-- Pelican body -->
  <ellipse cx="315" cy="195" rx="72" ry="52" fill="#f5f2ec" stroke="#c9c2b6" stroke-width="3"/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <polygon points="247,180 225,200 250,212" fill="#e0dbd2" stroke="#c9c2b6"/>
  <!-- Wing -->
  <path d="M272,178 Q300,232 342,224 Q322,168 272,178 Z" fill="#e0dbd2" stroke="#c9c2b6"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="405" cy="112" r="32" fill="#f5f2ec" stroke="#c9c2b6" stroke-width="3"/>
  <!-- Beak (upper) -->
  <polygon points="418,96 532,112 418,118" fill="#f2a33c" stroke="#d9822b" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Beak pouch (lower) -->
  <path d="M418,118 L532,112 Q508,142 448,136 Q428,128 418,118 Z" fill="#e0862c" stroke="#c6701f" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx="402" cy="100" r="4.5" fill="#333"/>
  <circle cx="403.5" cy="98.5" r="1.5" fill="#fff"/>
</svg>
```

The added neck path bridges the gap between the body's upper-right region and the head's lower region, giving the pelican a continuous head-to-body silhouette.
